return [{json:{...root,prospect:{firstName:p.firstName||'Taylor',company:p.company||'Vertex Logistics',role:p.role||'Director of Revenue Operations',industry:p.industry||'logistics',signal:p.signal||'recently expanded the sales team',painPoint:p.painPoint||'manual CRM updates and inconsistent follow-up'}}}];

parameters.content:
WHAT IT DOES: 

This workflow automatically generates highly personalized sales emails using AI. 


HOW IT DOES IT: 

It takes key information about a prospect, such as their name, company, role, industry, recent business activity, and pain points, sends that information to GPT-5 to create a customized subject line, opening, value proposition, call to action, and complete email, then formats the response into a clean, structured output that can be sent, logged, or passed to other business systems. 


WHY PAY FOR IT: 

It eliminates the time and effort of manually writing personalized outreach, allowing sales teams to produce high-quality emails in seconds, increase response rates, scale outbound prospecting, and free employees to focus on closing deals instead of writing repetitive emails.
